assets.label: Fig2
assets.caption: Figure 2.Overview of the proposed training framework.The FourierISP generator [6] decomposes the RAW-to-sRGB mapping into three sub-networks:PhaseNet(structuralreconstruction,frozenafterwarmup),AmplitudeNet(tonalrestoration),andColorAdaptationNet (fusion and refinement).Our contributions surround the generator:a ViT-based color discriminator operating on Gaussian-blurred images for global color distribution matching, an Inverse Net for cycle-consistency content anchoring through pixel-level and VGG-19 perceptual losses, and a four-phase curriculum training schedule.
